text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after perimeter running.
At Nakayama Festa's strong insistence,
we took a short break nearby.
choice_data_list: It's rare to see you wanting street food.
It's rare to see you wanting street food.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyone would be hungry
after finishing a run, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Anyone would..."
Hearing that, I suddenly noticed the lively buzz around us.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~! After working so hard on those hill sprints,
this tastes wickedly good~♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's wonderful, Spe-chan.
It looks like you've really gotten the hang of your own way of running on slopes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! When the hill is long or steep,
it's way easier to just yell, "Uoryaaah!" and sprint up—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And so, whenever I hear footsteps closing in from behind, I just get all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But if we use that to our advantage
and plan our race strategy around it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Other Umamusume who seemed to have finished their runs were chatting away animatedly.
Watching them from a distance with her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It is a scene that could truly be called a page out of youth. When I tell her that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, she simply laughed.
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, her running had improved.
What could have happened overnight...?
The only thing that came to mind was—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A rest area like that is a melting pot of information.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"I figured out how to enjoy the thrill with them.
Now all that's left is to master it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I could only marvel in utter awe at Nakayama Festa's sheer shrewdness.
